title: Grok Bot Launches Free Monitoring Tools for X

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The Grok Bot AI agent now possesses the capability to search, read, and track live activity on the X platform. These monitoring tools allow the bot to observe evolving situations and specific discussions in real time at no additional cost.

The updated functionality expands the bot's utility by integrating persistent network observation into its feature set. This capability is now active for anyone with access to the agent.
